settings.name: Selection track name
settings.description: Name of the track in your data that holds the table of start and end times per animal (e.g. 'nesting' when nest_table.csv of the Nest Cluster Detection App was added with the Upload File from Cloud Storage App). This track is removed from the output. If it is not set or does not exist, the App returns NULL.

settings.name: Track name variable
settings.description: Name of the column in the selection track that holds the animal (track) names, e.g. 'track' for nest_table.csv. Names are matched exactly first; if there is no exact match, the cleaned name used by the Nest Cluster Detection App is tried. This setting is required.

settings.name: Start time variable
settings.description: Name of the column in the selection track with the start times (e.g. 'first_date' or 'attempt_start'). Format YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, in UTC. If not set or not found, each track is filtered from its first timestamp.

settings.name: End time variable
settings.description: Name of the column in the selection track with the end times (e.g. 'last_date' or 'attempt_end'). Format YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, in UTC. A date without time includes the full end day. If not set or not found, each track is filtered until its last timestamp.
